question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Get your act together

options.text: To organise yourself so that you can do something properly

solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Get your act together" means to start to organise oneself so that they effectively do things. (अपने आप को संगठित करना ताकि आप कुछ ठीक से कर सकें)

 
 
• **Example**: If you really want to pass your exams, you need to get your act together and start studying seriously.
 
 
 
• "To organise yourself so that you can do something properly," accurately describes the idiom.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **"To organise yourself so that you can do something properly".**
